svg.title: AWS Java operation flow
svg.desc: The call path stays SDK-native: request helpers prepare models, extensions call the selected client, and coroutine APIs await the async boundary.
svg.text: The call path stays SDK-native: helpers prepare requests, extensions call clients, and coroutine APIs await async boundaries.
sync support, async support, suspend extensions, or higher-level facades
short helper DSLs still produce AWS SDK request objects
sync wrappers move to IO; async wrappers await SDK futures
responses remain AWS SDK-native model types
No custom service abstraction is hidden: helpers produce SDK requests, call SDK clients, and return SDK responses.
